subject: Renewal + capacity top-up: billing corridor, PO, and net-term amendment
messages:
From: Samir Desai <s.desai@olivetech.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: OliveTech Billing <billing@olivetech.com>
Date: 2027-05-20T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Renewal and capacity top-up — billing corridor & PO

Hi Karthik,

We are close to signing the renewal and adding a +50% capacity top-up for Q3 usage. Finance asked me to confirm a couple of billing items before we finalize the PO:

- Can Redwood accept Net45 on this renewal (we are moving several vendors to Net45)?
- We want to route invoices to our central AP inbox (billing@olivetech.com) and attach the purchase order number on each invoice.
- Which billing contact should we put on the PO? Also let me know if you need a W-9 or other tax form.

I'm attaching a short request doc with the desired PO fields (OliveTech_PO_Request.pdf). We plan to issue the PO once we have the billing contact and Net-term confirmed.

Appreciate a quick confirmation — our procurement deadline is end of week.

Thanks,
Samir
Director, Procurement
OliveTech

Attachment: OliveTech_PO_Request.pdf (1 page, PDF)
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>

Cc: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-20T11:01:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal and capacity top-up — billing corridor & PO

Samir — thanks for the note and the PO template. Great to hear the capacity add is moving forward. Quick answers and next steps: 

- Net45: finance is generally OK with Net45 for renewals that include a committed capacity increase; I'll confirm with Marissa and route for approval.
- Invoice routing: please send PO to billing@olivetech.com and include the PO number on the invoice line items; we'll ensure our billing system picks that up.
- Billing contact: use this: Marissa Cole, Billing Ops (marissa_cole@redwood.com). Marissa — can you confirm any additional fields you need on the PO (entity name, remit address, EIN)?

If you can attach the signed PO when ready we'll start the amendment and DocuSign flow to capture the Net45 term and the capacity addendum. I'll add the deal id RDW-OLV-2027-0556 on our side so invoices match.

Happy to jump on a 15-min call if procurement wants to walk through the invoice header requirements.

Best,
Karthik
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Karthik / Priya — looping in billing ops details below so Samir and OliveTech have everything in one place. I reviewed the PO template; we should be good with Net45 but need formal approval from finance for this specific commit. Items we need from OliveTech to process the PO and switch invoice routing: 

1) Full legal entity name to appear on the PO (matching remit).
2) Remit address (for US payables).
3) EIN or VAT id (tax form if non-US).
4) The PO PDF (signed) with the PO number noted in the header AND on each invoice line.
5) Billing contact: Marissa Cole, marissa_cole@redwood.com, +1 415-555-0142.

Notes on process: once we receive the signed PO and tax form (if applicable) we'll:
- Create the billing ticket and attach the PO to the renewal amendment (DocuSign step).
- Finance will triage the Net45 approval (typically 1–2 business days for a committed renewal).
- If OliveTech needs consolidated monthly invoices vs per-invoice attachment, advise and we'll configure.

Attaching a short template that helps procurement capture the fields we need: Billing_Instructions_Template.xlsx

Marissa

Samir — received the PO and the tax folder, thanks. Next steps and expectations: 

1) I've kicked off the amendment and attached the PO to the DocuSign envelope: https://app.docusign.com/OT-2027-0556/amendment. That amends the subscription to include +50% committed capacity and records Net45. Please have the person who signed the PO complete the DocuSign step (should be one additional signature).

2) Marissa — finance approval for Net45 is requested; please confirm when processed.

3) Once the amendment completes we'll map sales invoices to billing@olivetech.com and issue consolidated monthly invoices with the PO number OT-2027-0556 on the header and each line item. Expected effective invoice date: first invoice after amendment signature (June 1 invoice reflecting May usage pro-rate on the commit add).

If any of OliveTech's AP team needs a short call to confirm invoice layout, I can set 15 min today.

Karthik
